name: Header
summary: Sticky site header with logo, primary navigation, action buttons, and cart-count support.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default responsive header height and spacing.

states.name: desktopNav
states.description: Desktop breakpoint reveals navigation and hides hamburger trigger.

behavior.name: primaryNavigation
behavior.description: Primary navigation should expose a labelled navigation region and current-page state.

behavior.name: mobileMenuTrigger
behavior.description: Mobile trigger should open the mobile navigation or drawer adapter.

behavior.name: cartCount
behavior.description: Cart count should update when commerce state changes and remain readable at small sizes.

properties.name: logo
properties.description: Brand name or brand image rendered by the logo link.

properties.name: logoHref
properties.description: Brand-home destination for the logo link.

properties.name: logoLabel
properties.description: Accessible name for the logo link when visible brand content is insufficient.

properties.name: navigationLabel
properties.description: Accessible name for the optional primary navigation region.

properties.name: navigation
properties.description: Target-owned primary navigation links and current-page markup.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: Button and link dependencies for search, cart, mobile navigation, or other target-owned global actions.

properties.name: cartCount
properties.description: Target-formatted cart count displayed by a composed cart action.

properties.name: mobileMenuTrigger
properties.description: Optional Button dependency that a target may connect to Mobile Menu or Drawer behavior.

accessibility: Use a labelled nav region for the primary navigation.
Expose current destination with aria-current when possible.
Keep cart-count changes understandable to assistive technology.
Mobile menu triggers need aria-expanded and aria-controls when they toggle a drawer.

shopify.notes: Should map navigation links, cart count, search trigger, and mobile menu trigger from theme data.
